name: Katai Futoshi
source:
The protagonist of this work. A longtime neighbor of Morimi, he's been doted on since childhood.

He has a pure, earnest personality and possesses a healthy sexual appetite for his age.

Morimi is the woman he's admired since childhood, and because of that, he can't stand up to her.

Having grown into a young, robust man, Futoshi is like a pet who obeys everything she says. 

She saw him as the perfect partner to form a sexual relationship with while keeping her secret.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/hitoduma_circle/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
